title: Medicaid Managed Care Account Patients and Late-Cancellation Fees on In-Person Appointments
content:
## Rule

When the patient's financial account was on the Medicaid Managed Care Account tier on the scheduled date of an In-Person Appointments visit whose cancellation is recorded with timing late, the late-cancellation fee the visit carries is never charged: it is recorded as waived at the moment the fee is decided, with reason Medicaid prohibition, as one waiver entry for the visit that references no assessed fee, for the amount of the late-cancellation fee the visit carries.

A fee recorded as waived at the moment it is decided is entered once for the visit, and no documentation is asked of the patient for it.

The late-cancellation fee the visit carries is fixed only after the visit's appointment record shows it cancelled with a timing class. Put the other way round: while the appointment record does not yet show the visit cancelled with a timing class, the fee the visit carries has no fixed amount.

| Point | What the records show |
|---|---|
| Tier | The Patient Financial Account was on the Medicaid Managed Care Account tier on the visit's scheduled date |
| Timing | The appointment record shows the cancellation with timing late |
| Entry | One waiver entry for the visit, reason Medicaid prohibition, referencing no assessed fee |
| Amount | The late-cancellation fee the visit carries |

## The waiver entry tool

**Capability.** `record_late_cancel_fee_prohibition_784c7051` records, on one late-cancelled in-person appointment, that its late-cancellation fee is not charged because the Medicaid fee prohibition applies, entering the fee amount the prohibition covers. One fee-waiver entry is added to the appointment's fee and deposit history: fee type `late_cancel_fee`, reason `medicaid_prohibition`, dated today, carrying the visit's scheduled date and encounter number copied from the appointment, with no assessed-fee entry referenced; the fee is never charged, so no charge reaches the financial account. The appointment itself is not changed.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `record_late_cancel_fee_prohibition_784c7051` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `appointment_id`: reference number of the late-cancelled in-person appointment, read from the appointment list returned by the appointment lookup for this patient; an identifier.
- `amount`: the late-cancellation fee amount the prohibition covers, in US dollars as a positive number with exactly 2 decimal places (cents), stored as given.

**Return.** A receipt with `appointment_event_id` (reference number of the new waiver entry), `appointment_id`, `event_type` (always `appointment_fee_waived`), `fee_type` (always `late_cancel_fee`), `waiver_reason` (always `medicaid_prohibition`), `amount` (the amount recorded, USD with 2 decimal places) and `event_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD). The presence of `appointment_event_id` confirms the entry was recorded; afterwards the visit's fee and deposit history lists the waiver entry with the amount supplied.
